item.title: Sons of Iran’s leader Ali Khamenei attend funeral, but Mojtaba is absent
item.description: Massive crowds gathered in Tehran to mourn Khamenei’s death, with chants calling for revenge against the US and Israel.

item.title: 50 Houthi fighters killed in renewed clashes in Yemen
item.description: Yemeni government officials say the Houthis launched a surprise offensive targeting army barracks in southern Hodeidah.

item.title: Iran's supreme leader absent as senior officials attend ayatollah's funeral
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei has not been seen in public since the attack which killed his father at the outset of the US-Israel war with Iran.

item.title: Watch: Lyse Doucet on emotion and politics at Tehran funeral of former supreme leader
item.description: The BBC's chief international correspondent reports from Tehran where funeral events are taking place in honour of Iran's former leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Nigeria says two nationals killed in South Africa amid rise of anti-migrant attacks
item.description: Nigeria's government said one of its nationals was reportedly killed by police officers "using gruesome interrogation techniques".

item.title: How Iran's new regime is very different to what came before

item.title: Emotion and politics merge in Tehran at funeral of former supreme leader
item.description: The BBC's chief international correspondent Lyse Doucet is in Tehran, where funeral events are taking place in honour of Iran's former leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Funeral of Iran's former supreme leader 'intensely political moment'
item.description: Authorities expect up to 20 million people to attend ceremonies across Iran and Iraq over the coming days.

item.title: BBC in Tehran as mourners gather for former supreme leader's funeral
item.description: Iranian authorities say they expect millions of people to take part in funeral commemorations for Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
